AWB 201189 shows Selling=Rp 31.416.500 (not 31.762.081) as required. Prorata candidate endpoint returns tax_amount & total_tariff, and prorata child shares are computed on ex-PPN basis.

sellingOf() correctly falls back to total_tariff when grand_total is 0; consider unit tests for the helper on FE.
Prorata description string uses int(_sales(awb)) which drops fractional rupiah — acceptable for display but note for PSAK reporting reconciliation.
